purpose: Source snapshot associated with the default Jcode executable installed on leowio-home.

source.git_parent_reason: Matching upstream ancestor; every file in this parent is present in the original build staging source.
source.file_manifest_format: Sort lines of <Git file mode> <SHA-256 of file bytes or symlink target> <relative POSIX path>\n; SHA-256 their UTF-8 concatenation. Exclude this receipt and .git, target, __pycache__ directories.
notes: The durable copy has later local edits; the original build staging snapshot is preserved here.
The test-only file crates/jcode-tui/src/tui/app/tests/remote_failover_routes.rs was updated shortly after binary compilation and is included as saved.

build.notes: This preserves source and build provenance. A new build from a Git checkout can embed different Git metadata; byte-identical output has not been asserted.

launcher_policy.automatic_updates: Launcher adds --no-update unless --no-update or --auto-update was explicitly supplied.
